newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico same-day peso closes weaker.
newsitem.headline: Mexico same-day peso closes weaker.

text.p: Mexico's same-day peso contract closed slightly weaker in quiet trading on Tuesday, as dealers looked forward to the Chrismas holiday.
The same-day peso closed 0.2 of a centavo weaker at 7.818/7.822 per dollar as dealers squared positions before the holiday, analysts said.
The 24-hour contract was trading 0.4 of a centavo stronger at 7.825/7.83, while the while the spot 48-hour contract was 0.75 of a centavo stronger at 7.830/7.835 per dollar.
